data.name: Xaverius

in_hebrew.name: זאביירוס
in_hebrew.meaning: זאביירוס הוא שם שפירושו האדון הבא להציל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: זאביירוס הוא שם שמקורו בשפה הבסקית ופירושו האדון הבא להציל. השם נגזר מהמילה הבסקית 'etxeberria' שפירושה הבית החדש או הבית של האדון. השם זאביירוס משויך לקדוש פרנסיסקו ז'אווייר, מיסיונר ישועי שפעל במאה ה-16 והיה ידוע בעבודתו המיסיונרית באסיה. השם הוא סמלי לשמירת האמונה והקשר לאלוהים.

in_greek.name: Ξαβέριος
in_greek.meaning: Ξαβέριος σημαίνει Ο Κύριος που έρχεται να σώσει
in_greek.long_meaning: Ξαβέριος είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από τη βασκική γλώσσα και σημαίνει Ο Κύριος που έρχεται να σώσει. Το όνομα συνδέεται με τον Άγιο Φραγκίσκο Ξαβέριο, έναν Ιησουίτη ιεραποστολό που δραστηριοποιήθηκε τον 16ο αιώνα και ήταν γνωστός για το έργο του στην Ασία. Το όνομα Ξαβέριος είναι σύμβολο πίστης και σύνδεσης με τον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Xaverius
in_latin.meaning: Xaverius significat Dominus qui venit salvare
in_latin.long_meaning: Xaverius est nomen origine bascicum quod significat Dominus qui venit salvare. Nomen connectitur cum Sancto Francisco Xaverio, missionario Iesuita qui in saeculo XVI operatus est et notus erat pro opere suo in Asia. Nomen Xaverius est symbolum fidei et coniunctionis cum Deo.

in_english.name: Xaverius
in_english.meaning: Derived from Basque, Xaverius means The Lord who comes to save
in_english.long_meaning: Xaverius is a name of Basque origin, meaning The Lord who comes to save. It is associated with Saint Francis Xavier, a 16th-century Jesuit missionary known for his work in Asia. The name symbolizes faith and connection to God, reflecting the saint's missionary spirit and dedication to spreading Christianity. Xaverius is a unique and meaningful name for parents seeking a name with strong spiritual significance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Xaverius has been historically associated with the Spanish Missionary St. Francis Xavier. He is known as the "Apostle of India" for his extensive missionary work converting Hindus and Muslims to Christianity. His name has been adopted by Catholic schools, universities, and institutions worldwide, inspiring devoted followers and fostering a strong cultural connection to the Catholic faith.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the name Xaverius is often associated with the belief in renewal and new beginnings. Saint Xavier himself is believed to have embodied this spirit with his dedicated missionary work, inspiring countless generations of devout Christians to follow in his footsteps. The name Xaverius can serve as a reminder of the power of redemption and the call to serve others, fueling a deep sense of spiritual growth and commitment to one's faith.

historical_references.reference: Saint Francis Xavier was born on April 7, 1506, in the Spanish town of Xavier, in the Kingdom of Navarre, which is now part of the Basque Country in Spain. He was the eldest of three brothers in a wealthy family. In 1534, he joined the Society of Jesus, founded by Ignatius of Loyola, and was ordained a priest in 1537.
historical_references.context: Early life and joining the Society of Jesuits

historical_references.reference: In 1541, Francis Xavier embarked on his mission to India, arriving in Goa on May 6, 1542. He spent the next 16 years spreading Christianity, establishing schools, and ministering to the sick and the poor. He is best known for his work in India and Japan, where he is considered a co-patron saint.
historical_references.context: Missionary work in India and Japan
